meta.description: Read, write, create, and convert single-cell objects across AnnData (Python), Seurat (R), and SingleCellExperiment (R). Use when loading 10X Cell Ranger output (raw vs filtered), importing or exporting h5ad/RDS/h5mu/zarr, building AnnData or Seurat objects from matrices, moving objects between Python and R, or debugging lost layers, transposed matrices, or mangled gene names during conversion.

key_strengths: Both P1 findings from the original audit were independently reproduced as fixed, on data this re-auditor built from scratch (not the fixer's saved files): schard::h5ad2sce(use.raw=TRUE) genuinely recovers a real .raw snapshot where zellkonverter's raw=TRUE still (correctly, per the new caveat) fails; the new Seurat->h5ad code block runs end to end and its documented scale.data-loss caveat is accurate.

The fix generalizes correctly beyond what the fixer tested: a Seurat object with two reductions (PCA + UMAP) built independently by this re-auditor shows both survive the h5ad round trip, not just the single PCA case the fix log verified.
Both cheap P2 fixes (schard's counts-layer drop, anndataR's R>=4.5 requirement) were independently reproduced as accurate on fresh data and in this live R 4.4.3 environment.
The redundancy pass is clean: usage-guide.md's Prerequisites/What-the-Agent-Will-Do/Tips sections were correctly collapsed into pointers at SKILL.md, with no unique content lost on inspection.
Untouched code paths (canonical raw/filtered loads, SeuratDisk warning) were regression-checked independently and still hold, confirming the fix did not introduce a regression elsewhere.

recommendations.title: scale.data workaround shows extraction but not how to persist it alongside the h5ad
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's scale.data workaround (`as.matrix(LayerData(seurat_obj, layer='scale.data'))`) extracts the matrix into an R object but does not show saving it to disk, even though the whole point of the workaround is to preserve the data that the h5ad conversion drops.
recommendations.root_cause: The caveat was added as a documentation fix for the P1 finding and stops at the extraction step rather than a full save-alongside pattern.
recommendations.fix: Add one more line showing a save call (e.g. `saveRDS(scale_data, 'scale_data.rds')` or `write.csv`), so the workaround is copy-pasteable end to end rather than requiring the agent to infer the persistence step.
